# EXECUTION PROMPT — LINEAR CYC-72 To-Ship Desk Grid Implementation

> Generated for target repo `cycleforge-app` from goal: *[LINEAR CYC-72] To-ship desk: one sheet-like grid — every pending order fully visible

One in-warehouse to-ship list on /shipping/orders where EVERY still-here order is fully visible in a single dense grid — Google-Sheets feel: open the page, all information is on screen, no tab navigation to see a fact. READ-ONLY scope: no new write controls, no customer tab, no messaging, no realtime patches (those are parked follow-ups).

Current state (verified 2026-08-28): `src/lib/dashboard-order-row-layout.ts` line 110 `ORDERS_QUEUE_COLUMNS` already carries select, order, age(Late), title(Product), stage, tester, testedAt, packer, packedAt, packStation, urgent, condition, qty, tracking — its doc comment already says "stage is a row fact, not a tab that swaps columns".

Work, in words:

1. Add the two missing columns to ORDERS_QUEUE_COLUMNS: **shipBy** (civil date from deadline_at / ship_by_date) and **exception** (order_flags minus priority: Hold / Damaged / Awaiting customer). Empty cells stay empty — that is the truth until events land.
2. The in-set is one query: labeled + tracked, no SHIP_CONFIRM (awaiting test, tested, packed-staged, blocked). Stage comes from resolveOrderLifecycleStage — `src/lib/order-lifecycle.ts` line 79 `UNSHIPPED_LIFECYCLE_RULES`. Remove the Shipped tab from the to-ship desk shell (`src/components/outbound/orders/to-ship/ToShipWmsShell.tsx`) — shipped rows leave this desk; stage tabs stop being navigation.
3. One facet dropdown over the SAME list (never a column-model swap): All · Must ship · Urgent · Out of stock · Awaiting customer. Wire the declared-but-dead `?late=1` param so it actually filters. Must ship = days-late >= 0.
4. KPI strip (`src/lib/dashboard/outbound-metrics.ts`): keep Pending / Urgent / Out of stock, add Must ship; clicking a tile sets the same facet.
5. Ancestor scroll: pass `scrollParentRef` (declared at `src/design-system/components/grid/LedgerGridSurface.tsx` line 208) so the KPI card scrolls with the page instead of freezing a wall.
6. Row click keeps the existing ?openOrderId= inspector path — do not invent a second inspector.

House rules that bind: no geometry animation; interaction budget — the primary information of this page is visible in <=2 interactions (open page; optional facet), primary action <=3. Verify with `npm run verify:fast`. Visual acceptance: /shipping/orders opens to one grid showing order/late/product/tracking/stage/tester/packer/location/ship-by/urgent/exception for every in-warehouse order, a facet dropdown, a Must-ship KPI tile, and no Shipped tab.
